lines.zh: 翅膀一收，我贴着地面滑。
lines.en: Wings tucked, I skim the ground.
My heels never land; the wind carries me.
The treetops slide beneath my shoulders.
Flying is faster than running for me.
A line of dust rises behind me.

lines.zh: 这条道上的活物我都数过。
lines.en: I have counted every living thing on this road.

lines.zh: 两格高的身板，在林中正好。
lines.en: Two blocks tall fits well in the woods.
I pass the trees without slowing.
Hear the wings, and it is already late.
I fly and hunt for ki at once.
The wind pulls my wing membrane taut.
The target is just ahead.
I float midair, fanning my wings.
This quiet makes me restless.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一振，就到你头顶。
lines.en: One beat of my wings and I am overhead.
My master has not given the order.
I taste the ki in the air.
This area is too clean.
I fold my wings behind me.
Tambourine's wings beat lightly.
One order and I move.
I clench my teeth, bored with waiting.
From high up I see better.
Nobody passes above me.
I count breaths and hold my temper.
When the wind shifts, I know.
You have ki, though very little.
I took you in at a glance.
Your weapon will not stop wings.
You look up to find me.
I am behind you.
Only noticing now?
Your hand is creeping to your belt.
Take your time; I am in no hurry.
You stand straight; a decent act.
Your ki is trembling.
Dust on your face; you ran here.
Will you be faster if you run?
I have counted your steps.
You are a little taller than the last one.
The last one did not last three blows.
Where are your eyes going?
I am right here.
Anything left to say?

lines.zh: 我偏了一下，落地时歪了脚。
lines.en: I twist aside and land badly.
A hole is punched in my wing.
This will not stop me flying.
I bite down and make no sound.
Blood runs down the wing membrane.
I back half a block and spread my wings again.
You did hit me.
This body is not that fragile.
I breathe in; my ki is scattered.
I roll and take to the air again.
Such food is beneath me.

lines.zh: 扔过来也不会改变什么。
lines.en: Throwing it here changes nothing.
My master did not tell me to feed.
That much is not worth a look.
Keep it; you will need it running.
The smell drifts up.
I smell it, and I do not move.
Eat, and you still die.
Raise your hands higher.
I will not take it.
You hit me from the wrong side.
One wingbeat and you are shoved back.
Do not touch my wing membrane.
I sweep over your head.
You cannot step on me.
That much force the wind scatters.
You knocked me half a block off course.
Stand up; do not fall at my feet.
I turn aside once.
Trying again will not help.
I only obey orders.

lines.zh: 这种事不在我的任务里。
lines.en: That is not part of my task.
My master did not teach me this.
These wings are not for show.
I have no interest in that.
Do not come closer.
My kind do not live that way.
Lower your hands and speak of something else.
That question is dull.
Be quiet.
I take what falls, in passing.
Whose is this? It does not matter.
I flick it up with a claw tip.
It may be useful when I report back.
This thing is worthless.
I tuck it into the strap at my waist.
Anything else on the ground?
Do not stoop; I am watching you.
One squeeze and it is gone.
Never mind; throw it away.
Your ki shines through the trees.
A mile away, I still know you.
My wings are already spread.
From here to you, two breaths.
Do not look up for me.
I am already at your flank.

lines.zh: 我这副翅膀，专为追人长的。
lines.en: These wings were grown for chasing.

lines.zh: 你跑的方向，我已经堵住。
lines.en: I have already blocked your route.
The order is a single word.
I know what to do.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝，出卖了你。
lines.en: The branch you snapped gave you away.
Your breath has scattered.
Raise your hands and let me see.
This will be quick.
I wait for your mistake.
Now. Run.

lines.zh: 我在树梢上换了个位置。
lines.en: I shift to another treetop.
You keep watching the ground.
That is the last place to look.
My wings sound above your head.
You raise a hand to block.
You cannot block the wind.
I changed altitude.
You turn your head after me.
Your neck will ache.
Your hands are soaked.
I wait for your ki to drop.
It will drop.
You have backed to the stone wall.

lines.zh: 石壁挡不住从上面来的。
lines.en: A wall cannot stop what comes from above.
Your gasps grow shorter.
Small ki blasts line up between my fingers.
A ki blast is gathered in my palm.
The moment you look up, I move.
I dive from above.
My claws open your shoulder.
A knee drives you back.
A ki blast bursts against you.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇起的风先压住你。
lines.en: The wind of my wings pins you first.
I rake my claws across your wrist.
This one goes for your throat.
My toe taps your chest.
I dive with my wings folded.
The moment you block, I change angle.

lines.zh: 气弹连发，你只躲开一半。
lines.en: A volley of ki blasts; you dodge half.
I kick the back of your knee.
That one cost me little.
Claw marks remain on your armor.
Your weapon swung through air.
My heel lands on your chest.
I come down from above.
My wings land in the shadow first.
This area has no master yet.
The order has been received.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀展开，量了量宽度。
lines.en: I spread my wings to measure their span.

lines.zh: 空气里全是活物的味道。
lines.en: The air is thick with the smell of living things.
Two blocks of height is enough.
Let me see who is here.
This place is unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 翼一收，落地连尘都不起。
lines.en: Wings folded, I land without raising dust.
Whoever moves first is my first pick.
I fold my wings and stand straight.
The wind blows from my side.
This stretch will grow quiet.
Do not ask who I am.
Ask, and I still will not answer.
Let us begin.
My claws are already sharpened.

lines.zh: 火焰烧到翼膜，我扇了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my membrane; I beat it out.

lines.zh: 我从空中坠下去，翅膀撑住了。
lines.en: I drop from the air and my wings catch me.
Wet wings drag me downward.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹得翻了半圈。
lines.en: The blast rolls me half a turn.
Something sharp punches through my wing.

lines.zh: 那道光把我的气锁住了。
lines.en: That light locks my ki in place.

lines.zh: 饿着肚子，气弹聚不起来。
lines.en: Hungry, I cannot gather a ki blast.
Lightning runs down my wing into my spine.
There is nothing beneath my wings.
